About Toolstack Lab Games

Toolstack Lab Games is where Toolstack Lab publishes small browser games: mostly 3D, plus a few selected classics. Two of the four are our own; each classic is a clearly-licensed open-source game, credited to its author on its page. Press Play and it loads right in the page. No accounts, and no third-party scripts or fonts on these pages. No ads, no cookies, no scripts that track individuals; we only use cookie-free visit counting, inside our own games.

What you get

  • Games we made ourselves, plus a few selected open-source classics. Each game page shows its licence and source.
  • Nothing heavy loads until you press Play. You can also open any game in its own tab.
  • The ranking uses visits from the last 14 days. Visit counts cover Toolstack Lab's own games only. “Recently played” stays on your device only.

Games we make

  • Spud Fling: Fling a googly-eyed potato, smash crates, unlock boosts, chase a new best. Licence and source
  • Pip's Bloom Isle: A cozy 3D platformer-collector: tend four island levels with Tansy while Pip cheers. Licence and source

Classics we host

  • Merge Tiles: by Gabriele Cirulli et al., MIT licence. Licence and source
  • Moon Rover: Anaxagoras: by winch, MIT licence. Licence and source

The lab cartridge idea

Every game gets the same cartridge card with a label plate and a serial number (TSL·01, TSL·02…). On a game page, Play docks the cartridge into the play bay. That is the one bit of motion on the site; there are no video or 3D backgrounds.

Who the games are for

Spud Fling suits anyone who likes quick one-button rounds. Pip's Bloom Isle is aimed at casual players 13+. Merge Tiles is an open-source classic by Gabriele Cirulli et al.; its page explains how it plays and who made it. Moon Rover: Anaxagoras is an open-source classic by winch; its page explains how it plays and who made it. We only describe what each build already ships. The content policy sets out which games may be listed.

Contact

Parent site: gettoolstacklab.com. The hub's source is public on GitHub as madlouse/toolstack-games.

How the hub works

  1. 1Pick a cartridge. Each game is one card: a real in-game frame, a short pitch, three tags.
  2. 2Press Play. The game docks into the play bay on its page and starts loading at once.
  3. 3Play in the page. Nothing to install. Progress stays in your own browser.
